Cost: 1 Investiture

I have found you wanting.

Spend 1 Investiture and test Black vs. Cognitive against a creature in Attunement Range. On success, until the start of your next turn, that creature's die size for all tests decreases by one step (minimum d4).

description.value:
Activation: 2

Cost: 2 Investiture

You have been judged. You have been found lesser.

Spend 2 Investiture and test Black vs. Spiritual against a creature in Attunement Range. On success, for the scene, that creature's die size for attack tests decreases by two steps (minimum d4), and each time it fails an attack test, each ally in Attunement Range gains temporary HP equal to your Tier. On failure, decrease its die size by one step until the start of your next turn.

Activation: 1

Cost: 2 Investiture

One rises. One falls. That is the natural order.

Spend 2 Investiture and choose one willing ally and one enemy in Attunement Range. Until the start of your next turn, the ally's die size for all tests increases by one step (maximum d12) and the enemy's die size decreases by one step (minimum d4). If the ally hits the enemy this round, both effects extend by one additional round.
